title: She slowly spins in an office chair while hugging a notebook to her chest like…
content: She slowly spins in an office chair while hugging a notebook to her chest like she is orbiting around a crush in her imagination, then stops facing the wrong direction and smiles shyly. Soft daylight, cute surreal work-life romance mood, realistic camera

es.content:

Luz suave de día, ambiente romántico cute y surrealista de vida laboral, cámara realista
